name: llm-wiki
description: Global LLM Wiki second brain cloned to ~/wiki, configured by its own setup.sh (plugin, skills, session-sync hooks)

claude.uninstall_note: To remove it: claude plugin uninstall llm-wiki@llm-wiki; delete ~/.claude/skills/llm-wiki-session-capture and ~/.claude/commands/wiki/capture-session.md; remove the wiki hooks from ~/.claude/settings.json and the LLM Wiki stanza from ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md. ~/wiki itself is kept.

omp.uninstall_note: To remove it: delete ~/.omp/agent/skills/llm-wiki and ~/.omp/agent/skills/llm-wiki-session-capture, the wiki-sync extension in ~/.omp/agent/extensions, and the LLM Wiki stanza from ~/.omp/agent/AGENTS.md. ~/wiki itself is kept.
